packed_codebooks.bin from ww2ogg (Adam Gashlin, after the Xiph.Org Foundation's libvorbis codebooks; BSD-3-Clause:
COPYING): the 598 standard Vorbis codebooks that the Wwise Vorbis of Red Faction: Armageddon's sounds (Wwise 2009,
bank version 48) names by number instead of storing in each file. RFA-Mod's sound engine rebuilds each file's
Vorbis setup header from them, as ww2ogg does. (ww2ogg's other library, packed_codebooks_aoTuV_603.bin, is for later
Wwise: Armageddon's files don't decode with it, so it isn't kept.)

Taken unchanged, fetched 2026-11-26 with the user's OK:
